propositions: Close gate with --class duplicate and no recorded duplicates link falls through to LLM verifier which fails but never mentions the required 'rebar link' command
Hard fail should be raised for bug closed as duplicate with no live replacement link, with exact 'rebar link <id> <canonical> duplicates' command in error message
Requirement is link existence only; link target may be closed or open, and gate should not require target to be open
Dead/archived target named in link should produce distinct error message from no-link case
Classes not_a_bug and escalated should retain fallthrough behavior unchanged; hard fail applies to duplicate class only
Hard fail must occur before any LLM billable call to avoid cost on invalid close attempts
